rows: t85j
When did Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come to Jerusalem to surround the city and cut off all supplies to it?
Nebuchadnezzar came to Jerusalem in the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah.
f2nj
Who gave Nebuchadnezzar victory over Jehoiakim king of Judah?
The Lord gave Nebuchadnezzar victory over Jehoiakim.
xubo
What did the king tell Ashpenaz to do?
The king told Ashpenaz to bring to Babylon some of the people of Israel, both of the royal family and of the nobility.
s19d
What kind of young men did the king want to be brought to Babylon?
The king wanted young men without blemish, attractive in appearance, skillful in all wisdom, filled with knowledge and understanding, qualified to serve in the king’s palace.
nz9t
What was the king’s daily arrangement for these young men’s food and drink?
Each day the king assigned them a portion of his own food and of the wine he drank, and he arranged for them to be trained for three years.
uihu
What were the names of some of these young men from Israel and what names were they given by the chief official?
Daniel was called Belteshazzar; Hananiah was called Shadrach; Mishael was called Meshach, and Azariah was called Abednego.
w4qo
What did Daniel decide in his heart?
Daniel decided in his heart that he would not defile himself by eating the king’s food or drinking his wine.
g4wp
What did God cause the chief official to do toward Daniel?
God caused the chief official to show favor and compassion to Daniel.
xvis
How did the chief official respond when Daniel asked him to be allowed not to eat the king’s food and wine?

The chief official told Daniel that he feared the king, who had assigned Daniel’s food and drink, and that the king might behead him if he saw Daniel looking worse than the other young men of his age.
n77u
What did Daniel ask of the steward who had been assigned over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah?

Daniel asked the steward to test them for ten days by giving them only vegetables to eat and water to drink, and then to compare their appearance with that of the young men who ate the king’s food, and then decide what to do based on what he saw.
z8tu
After the steward agreed to the test, what did he observe after ten days when he compared Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah to the other young men?
The steward observed that Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah looked healthier and better fed than all the young men who ate the king’s food.
k7dz
What did the steward do after seeing how well Daniel and his friends looked?
The steward continued to take away their portion of the king’s food and wine and gave them vegetables instead.
na41
What did God give to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah?
God gave them knowledge and skill in all literature and wisdom, and Daniel understood all visions and dreams.
m3qv
Who brought the young men before King Nebuchadnezzar at the end of the three years?
The chief of the eunuchs brought them before Nebuchadnezzar.
uffy
What did the king find when he spoke with the whole group of young men?

The king found that none of them could compare with Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah. In every matter of wisdom and understanding that the king asked them about, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his whole kingdom.
rs4c
Until when was Daniel in Babylon?
He was there until the first year of King Cyrus.
k26r
When did Nebuchadnezzar have dreams that troubled his mind so that he could not sleep?
This occurred in the second year of his reign.
wlvi
Why did the king summon the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans?
The king wanted these men to tell him about his dreams.
b3qk
What did the king tell his advisors about his dream?
The king told them that he had dreamed a dream and that he wanted to know what it meant.
c4pl
What did the Chaldeans ask the king to do?
The Chaldeans asked the king to tell them the dream so they could tell him what it meant.
vgxd
What did the king specifically want the wise men to do?
The king wanted the wise men to reveal the dream to him and also to interpret the meaning of the dream for the king.
dse9
What did the king say would happen to the wise men if they failed to tell the king his dream and interpret it for him?
The king said that if they failed, their bodies would be cut into pieces and their houses would be turned into piles of rubbish.
dzrg
What did the king say he would do for the person or people who revealed the dream to him and interpreted it?
The king said he would give that person or persons gifts, a reward, and great honor.
d7mt
What did the advisors say again to the king?
They said again that the king should tell them the dream, and they would tell him what it meant.
f8nq
What did the king say the advisors were doing?
The king said that the advisors were trying to get more time because they knew he would carry out what he had said.
g9wr
What did the king say the advisors had agreed to do?
The king said they had agreed to tell him a false explanation until the situation changed.
hkhh
Who did the Chaldeans say could do what the king asked concerning his dream?
The Chaldeans said that there was not a man on earth who could meet the king’s demand, only the gods could do that.
h2vt
How did the king feel after the advisors said they could not tell him his dream?
The king became extremely angry, and he commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be executed.
jiow
After the wise men’s reply to Nebuchadnezzar, what did the king decree?
The king decreed that all those known for their wisdom were to be put to death.
mpnf
How did Daniel interact with Arioch when he came to Daniel?
Daniel replied with prudence and discretion to Arioch. He asked Arioch why the king’s decree was so urgent.
tffi
Who was Arioch?
He was the captain of the king’s guard, the one who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.
ps76
What did Daniel request after speaking with Arioch?
Daniel went in and asked the king to give him time so that he could tell the king what his dream meant.
j7xn
What did Daniel do when he went to his house?
Daniel told his friends Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah what had happened.
k8yq
What did Daniel ask his friends to seek from the God of heaven?
Daniel asked them to seek mercy from the God of heaven about the mystery, so that he and his friends would not be killed with the other wise men of Babylon.
aaxn
What did Daniel do after the secret was revealed to him?
Daniel praised the God of heaven.
m2ab
What did Daniel say about God’s wisdom and power?
Daniel said that wisdom and power belong to God, and that God’s name should be blessed forever.
n3cd
What did Daniel say God does with kings and with wisdom?
Daniel said that God removes kings and sets up kings, and that God gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who understand.
p4ef
What did Daniel say God reveals and knows?
Daniel said God reveals deep and hidden things, and that God knows what is in the darkness because the light is with him.
s4p6
For what did Daniel thank the God of his ancestors?
Daniel thanked the God of his ancestors for the wisdom and power the God of his ancestors had given him.
jw14
Who did Daniel go see after the secret was revealed to him?
Daniel went in to see Arioch.
What did Daniel tell Arioch?
Daniel told Arioch not to kill the wise men in Babylon. Daniel told Arioch to escort him before the king so Daniel could tell the king the dream’s meaning.
q5gh
What did Arioch tell the king about Daniel?
Arioch told the king that he had found a man from the captives of Judah who could tell the king the interpretation of his dream.
r6ij
What did the king ask Daniel?
The king asked Daniel whether he was able to tell him the dream that he had seen and its interpretation.
s7kl
What did Daniel say about the wise men, enchanters, magicians, and diviners?
Daniel said that they were not able to show the king the mystery that he had asked about.
xhcq
When Daniel was brought in to the king, who did Daniel say could reveal the mystery the king had demanded?
Daniel said there is a God who lives in the heavens, who reveals secrets.
mu0f
In general what did Daniel say the king’s dream was about?
Daniel said the dream was about what would happen in the days to come.
t8mn
What did Daniel say the king had been thinking about while on his bed?
Daniel said the king had been thinking about what will happen in the future, and that God had revealed to him what that will be.
r1bg
Why was the dream revealed to Daniel?
The dream was revealed to Daniel so that the king might understand the meaning and know the thoughts deep within himself.
cwpd
What did the statue that the king saw in his dream look like?
The statue was large and had a head of gold, a chest and arms of silver, its middle and thighs were bronze, its legs of iron and its feet part iron and part clay.
u9op
What were the feet of the statue made of?
The feet of the statue were made partly of iron and partly of clay.
cnl1
What happened to the statue the king saw in his dream?
The king saw a stone cut, but not by human hands. The stone struck the statue’s feet and the whole statue shattered into pieces which the wind carried away.
szdb
What happened to the stone that struck the statue?
The stone that struck the statue became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
v2qr
What did Daniel say he and his friends would do after telling the king his dream?
Daniel said they would tell the king the interpretation of the dream.
w3st
What did Daniel say God had given to the king?
Daniel said God had given the king the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.
aje5
Who was the head of gold?
King Nebuchadnezzar was the head of gold.
x4uv
What did Daniel say would happen after the king’s kingdom?
Daniel said another kingdom would arise after his, and then a third kingdom of bronze would rule over all the earth.
y5wx
What did Daniel say the fourth kingdom would be like?
Daniel said the fourth kingdom would be strong like iron, and it would crush and break all the other kingdoms.
z6yz
What did the feet and toes made of clay and iron mean?
They meant that the kingdom would be divided, partly strong like iron and partly weak, because the king saw iron mixed with clay.
a7bc
What did the iron and clay in the toes of the statue represent?
They represented that part of the kingdom would be strong and part of it would be brittle.
b8de
What did Daniel say would happen even though the kingdoms would mix themselves by marriage?
Daniel said the kingdoms would not stay united with each other, just as iron does not mix with clay.
laj7
What will the God of heaven do in the days of the kingdom that is partly iron and partly clay?
In those days the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed or conquered by another people.
c9fg
What did Daniel say about the dream and its interpretation?
Daniel said the dream was certain and its interpretation was confirmed.
sgif
What did Nebuchadnezzar command to be done for Daniel after he finished telling the king the dream and its interpretation?
The king commanded an offering to be made and incense be offered up to Daniel.
auy7
What did Nebuchadnezzar say concerning Daniel’s God?
Nebuchadnezzar said Daniel’s God is the God of gods, the Lord of kings and the one who reveals secrets.
d2hi
What did the king do for Daniel after the interpretation?
The king made Daniel great, gave him many gifts, and made him ruler over the province of Babylon and chief over all the wise men of Babylon.
t9cp
What did Nebuchadnezzar do after Daniel made a request of the king?
The king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to be administrators over the province of Babylon.
vsqs
What were the dimensions of the gold statue that king Nebuchadnezzar made and set up on the Plain of Dura?
The statue was sixty cubits tall and six cubits wide.
b2ka
Who did King Nebuchadnezzar send to assemble for the dedication of the statue?
He sent messengers to assemble the satraps, the prefects, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the other officials of the provinces.
hpr5
Who came to the dedication of the statue that Nebuchadnezzar had made?
The provincial governors, regional governors, and local governors, together with the counselors, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the high officials of the provinces came to the dedication.
n7q6
What did Nebuchadnezzar want those in attendance at the dedication to do?
He wanted those in attendance to fall down and worship the golden statue when they heard the sound of the horns, flutes, lyres, zithers, harps, and bagpipes, and all kinds of music.
ol8n
What did the king command to happen to those who did not fall down and worship the statue when they heard all the instruments and the music?
The king said that those who would not fall down and worship, at that very moment, would be thrown into a blazing furnace.
b7fq
What did the peoples, nations, and languages do when they heard the sound of the music?
They fell down and worshiped the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
l1nr
Who brought accusations against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego?
Certain Chaldeans came and brought accusations against them.
b9lm
What did the Chaldeans say to the king before they accused Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego?
They wished the king a long life before making their accusation.
c0tz
What decree did the Chaldeans remind the king that he had made?
They reminded him that he had decreed that everyone who heard the music must fall down and worship the golden statue.
c1vb
What did the Chaldeans say would happen to anyone who did not worship the statue?
They said that person would be thrown into a blazing furnace.
dvlq
Who did not fall down and worship the statue?
Certain Jews, their names being Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, would not fall down and worship the statue.
c3hn
What did Nebuchadnezzar command when he heard the accusation against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego?
He angrily commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought before him, and they were brought before the king.
c4pw
What did Nebuchadnezzar ask Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego?
He asked them if it was true that they did not serve his gods or worship the golden statue he had set up.
c5rk
What did Nebuchadnezzar tell Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego would happen if they refused to worship the statue?
He told them they would immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace, and no god would be able to rescue them from his power.
c6dj
What did Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego tell the king?
They told him that they did not need to answer him about this matter.
n0d5

What was the response of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego to the king when the king repeated the command to fall down and worship the statue, and stated the consequences if they did not follow the king’s command?

Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego responded that their God could and would keep them safe and rescue them from the blazing furnace. But even if not, they would not worship Nebuchadnezzar’s gods or prostrate themselves to the statue.
qys5
What did Nebuchadnezzar command concerning Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego?
Nebuchadnezzar ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than normal, and for Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego to be tied up and thrown into the furnace.
d1sq
How were Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego dressed when they were thrown into the furnace?
They were bound in their cloaks, tunics, turbans, and other garments when they were thrown into the blazing furnace.
ahg7
What happened to Shadrach, Meshach, Abednego and the men who took them to put them in the furnace?
The men who took up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego were killed by the very hot flames from the furnace and Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego fell into the furnace.
d4mx
What did Nebuchadnezzar ask his counselors after he saw something amazing in the furnace?
He asked them if they had not thrown three men, bound, into the fire, and they answered that it was true.
p3tg
What caused Nebuchadnezzar to be amazed and stand up quickly?
Nebuchadnezzar was amazed because he saw four men, not tied up, walking around in the fire and they were not hurt and the brilliance of the fourth man was like a son of the gods.
d6tf
What did Nebuchadnezzar say to Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego at the door of the furnace?
He called for the servants of the Most High God to come out, and they came out of the fire.
y6oi
What did those present observe about Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego after they came out of the fire?
Those present observed that the fire had not hurt their bodies; the hair on their heads was not singed; their robes were not harmed; and there was no smell of fire on them.
d8ny
What did Nebuchadnezzar say about the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego?
He said that God was blessed because he sent his angel and rescued his servants, who were willing to give up their bodies rather than serve or worship any other god.
nja9
What decree did Nebuchadnezzar issue after the event of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego and the blazing furnace?

Nebuchadnezzar decreed that anyone from any people, nation, or language who spoke against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego would be cut into pieces and their house destroyed, because no other god is able to save like this one.
wett
What did the king do for Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego?
Nebuchadnezzar, the king, promoted Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.
x2h2
To whom did Nebuchadnezzar send the decree?
Nebuchadnezzar sent the decree to all peoples, nations, and languages who lived on the earth.
fpar
Why did Nebuchadnezzar send the decree?
Nebuchadnezzar sent the decree to tell everyone about the signs and wonders the Most High had done for him.
lk9j
What did Nebuchadnezzar say about the Most High?
Nebuchadnezzar said that the Most High’s signs are great and his wonders are mighty, that his kingdom lasts forever, and that he rules over every generation.
qz4t
How was Nebuchadnezzar living before he had his dream?
Nebuchadnezzar was living securely in his house and prospering in his palace.
miye
What made Nebuchadnezzar afraid?
A dream that Nebuchadnezzar saw frightened him, and the thoughts and visions in his mind alarmed him.
mn8x
Why did Nebuchadnezzar issue a decree to bring before him all the wise men of Babylon?
Nebuchadnezzar wanted the wise men of Babylon to come and interpret his dream for him.
hf3k
What happened when Nebuchadnezzar told his dream to the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and diviners?
They were not able to tell Nebuchadnezzar what the dream meant.
ud2s
What was Daniel’s Babylonian name and what was Daniel’s position in Nebuchadnezzar’s kingdom?
Daniel’s Babylonian name was Belteshazzar and he held the position of “chief of the magicians.”
trqj
Who did Nebuchadnezzar believe was able to tell the interpretation of his dream?
Nebuchadnezzar believed Daniel could interpret his dream for him, for Nebuchadnezzar said of Daniel, “the spirit of the holy gods is in you, so no mystery is too hard for you to explain.”
ksjo
What did Nebuchadnezzar see in the first part of his dream?
Nebuchadnezzar saw a great, strong, beautiful tree that reached to the heavens. It provided shade for animals and an abode for the birds. It had abundant fruit that fed all living creatures.
wli1
What did the holy messenger from the heavens say to do to the tree?
The holy messenger said to chop down the tree, cut off its branches, strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit.
gvby
What was to be done with the tree stump?
The stump was to be left in the earth, bound with a band of iron and bronze. Let it be wet with dew. Let it live with the animals. Let his mind be that of an animal and not of a man for seven years.
o9tx
What was the purpose of doing this to the tree in Nebuchadnezzar’s dream?
The purpose was to show Nebuchadnezzar that those who are alive would know that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of peoples and gives them to anyone he wishes to place over them.
bn7w
What did Nebuchadnezzar tell Belteshazzar about his other wise men?
Nebuchadnezzar said that none of his other wise men were able to tell him the interpretation of the dream, but Belteshazzar was able because the spirit of the holy gods was in him.
dp2m
How did Daniel react when he first understood the dream?
Daniel was appalled for a moment, and his thoughts alarmed him.
ck8s
What details did Daniel repeat about the tree Nebuchadnezzar saw in his dream?
Daniel said the tree had become great and strong, reached to the heavens, and could be seen from all the earth; it had beautiful leaves and much fruit, and animals and birds lived in it.
ps3c
Who did Daniel say the tree was in Nebuchadnezzar’s dream?
Daniel said the tree was Nebuchadnezzar.
tv5j
What did Daniel say the holy messenger told Nebuchadnezzar to do to the tree?
Daniel said the holy messenger told Nebuchadnezzar to cut down the tree but leave its stump bound with iron and bronze in the field, wet with dew, until seven times passed over him.
lm9q
Whose decree did Daniel say was coming upon King Nebuchadnezzar?
Daniel said it was the decree of the Most High that was coming upon King Nebuchadnezzar.
rn2c
What was to happen to Nebuchadnezzar until he acknowledged that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of people and gives them to anyone he wishes?
Nebuchadnezzar was to be driven from among men. He would live in the fields with the wild animals and eat grass like an ox and be wet with the dew from the heavens.
u4l1
How long was it to be before Nebuchadnezzar would acknowledge that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of people and he gives them to anyone he wishes?
Seven years were to pass until Nebuchadnezzar acknowledged that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of people and he gives them to anyone he wishes.
wr4n
What did leaving the stump of the tree represent?
Leaving the stump represented that Nebuchadnezzar’s kingdom would remain for him once he acknowledged that heaven rules.
yg54
After interpreting the dream for Nebuchadnezzar, what was Daniel’s advice for him?
Daniel advised Nebuchadnezzar to stop sinning and to do what was right. He also told Nebuchadnezzar to turn away from his sins by showing mercy to the poor.
gscr
How long was it before the interpretation of Nebuchadnezzar’s dream began to happen?
All these things began to happen twelve months after his dream.
xh2f
What did Nebuchadnezzar say about himself as he looked at Babylon?
Nebuchadnezzar said that he had built Babylon by his own power and for the glory of his majesty.
jt6p
What happened while Nebuchadnezzar was still speaking?
A voice from heaven said that the kingdom had passed from Nebuchadnezzar.
qm8v
What did the voice from heaven say would happen to Nebuchadnezzar?
The voice said Nebuchadnezzar would be driven away from people to live with the wild animals and eat grass like an ox until he acknowledged that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of people.
fz3k
What happened to Nebuchadnezzar immediately after the voice spoke?
Nebuchadnezzar was driven away from people, ate grass like oxen, and his hair grew long like eagles’ feathers and his nails like birds’ claws.
What happened to Nebuchadnezzar at the end of the seven years?
Nebuchadnezzar’s sanity was restored to him.
rmky
What did Nebuchadnezzar do after his sanity was restored to him?
Nebuchadnezzar praised and honored the Most High who rules forever.
nb5r
What did Nebuchadnezzar say about the Most High’s power over the earth and the heavens?

Nebuchadnezzar said that the Most High regards all the people of earth as nothing and does as he wishes among the army of heaven and the people of earth, and no one can stop him or question what he does.
rmvp
What happened to Nebuchadnezzar’s kingdom?
The kingdom was given back to him.
rjtz
What was Nebuchadnezzar’s final statement concerning the King of heaven?
Nebuchadnezzar said, “Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and honor the King of heaven, for all his deeds are right and his ways are just. He is able to humble anyone who is proud.”
kg6z
For whom did Belshazzar, the king, make a great feast?
He made a great feast for a thousand of his nobles.
pz74
Who was this Belshazzar?
He was the grandson of Nebuchadnezzar.
c5xp
What containers did they use to drink the wine from at this feast?
They used the gold containers that had been taken out of the temple, the house of God, in Jerusalem.
etcr
What did the people at the feast do as they drank the wine?
They praised their idols made of gold and silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
q1pr
As the people were drinking wine and praising their idols, what happened?
The fingers of a human hand appeared in front of the lamp stand and wrote on the plaster wall in the king’s palace.
irfy
What was the king’s immediate response when he saw the hand?
His face turned pale, his thoughts terrified him, and his legs became so weak that his knees were shaking.
wbuj
What did the king promise to the one who could explain the writing on the plaster wall and its meaning?

The king promised that the one who explained the writing and its meaning would be clothed in purple and would have a gold chain put around his neck and that he would have the authority of the third highest ruler in the kingdom.
da8m
What happened when the king’s wise men came in to look at the writing?
They were not able to read the writing or tell the king what it meant.
da9k
What happened to King Belshazzar and his nobles when the wise men could not read the writing?
The king became even more afraid and his face grew pale, and his nobles were confused and did not know what to do.
db1q
Who came into the banquet hall because of what the king and his nobles were saying?
The queen came in and told the king not to be afraid and not to let his face turn pale.
db2r
According to the queen, what position did King Nebuchadnezzar give to this man?
Nebuchadnezzar made him chief over the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and diviners.
db3s
What did the queen tell the king to do?
She told him to call for Daniel, because Daniel would show the king the interpretation of the writing.
nbfl
According to the king what qualities did he say he had heard about Daniel?
The king said he had heard that the spirit of the gods was in Daniel, and that Daniel had light, understanding, and excellent wisdom.
db5v
What did the king tell Daniel about his wise men?
The king said his wise men had been brought in to read the writing, but they were not able to explain its interpretation.
db6w
What did the king promise Daniel if he could read the writing and explain it?
The king promised that Daniel would wear purple, have a gold chain around his neck, and rule as the third ruler in the kingdom.
jwzb
What was Daniel’s response when he was told of the rewards he would receive for reading the writing and explaining its meaning?
Daniel told the king, “Let your gifts be for yourself, and give your rewards to another person. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to you, king, and will tell you the meaning.”
db8y
According to Daniel, who gave Nebuchadnezzar the kingdom, greatness, honor, and majesty?
The Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar the kingdom, greatness, honor, and majesty.
db9z
What could Nebuchadnezzar do to anyone he wished, according to Daniel?
He could kill or let live anyone he wished, and he could lift up or humble anyone he wished.
okpo
Why was Nebuchadnezzar brought down from his kingly throne and why was his majesty taken away from him?
Nebuchadnezzar lost his majesty and his throne because his heart became arrogant and his spirit was hardened so that he acted presumptuously.
dc1a
Where did Nebuchadnezzar live after he was driven away from people?
He lived among the wild donkeys and ate grass like oxen until he knew that the Most High God rules over human kingdoms.
jdy9
What were Daniel’s charges against Belshazzar?
Daniel said Belshazzar had not humbled his heart, he had lifted himself up against the Lord of the heavens, and he had not honored the God who held his breath in his hand and who knew all his ways.
dc4d
According to Daniel, what was sent from God and wrote on the wall?
The palm of a hand was sent from God, and it wrote the message on the wall.
dc5e
What words were written on the wall?
The words were Mene, Mene, Tekel, and Parsin.
oyjw
What was the meaning of the writing on the plaster wall?

The meaning was as follows: God has numbered Belshazzar’s kingdom and brought it to an end. Belshazzar is weighed in the scales and found deficient. Belshazzar’s kingdom is divided and is given to the Medes and Persians.
dc9j
What did Belshazzar do for Daniel after Daniel explained the writing?
Belshazzar had Daniel clothed with purple and a gold chain around his neck, and proclaimed him the third ruler in the kingdom.
x5lu
What happened that night after Daniel gave his interpretation of the writing to Belshazzar?
That night Belshazzar, the king of the Chaldeans, was killed, and Darius the Mede received the kingdom.
ynwo
How old was Darius the Mede when he received the kingdom?
Darius the Mede was sixty-two years old when he received the kingdom.
d7dg
Who did Darius appoint over the kingdom?
He appointed 120 satraps, with three sareks over them.
c0pd
Who was one of the three sareks?
Daniel was one of the three sareks.
myx8
Why were the three sareks appointed?
They were appointed to supervise the satraps, so that the king would not suffer any loss.
wly9
Who was the king planning to put over the whole kingdom?
The king planned to put Daniel over the whole kingdom.
